# Error and warning codes

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_errors_doc.py from src/tokbin/codes.py. Do not edit. -->

Every tokbin error and warning carries a stable code `TB-<category><number>`. A code
never changes its meaning and is never reused, even after the error is removed.

An error message has three parts: what happened, why, and what to do:

```bash
[TB-I301] Shard is missing: corpus/web/train-00003.bin
  where: tokbin.read.source.read_source
  cause: meta.json lists 13 shards for 'train'; this one is not on disk
  fix:   download the shard again and run `tokbin verify corpus/web`
```

Numbering inside a category: 1xx on-disk format, 2xx writing, 3xx reading, inspection
and verification. Some codes label warnings and facts reported in the `issues` of a
result (for example `TB-C215`, `TB-S203`) rather than exceptions.

| `TB-C204` | Invalid split name |
| `TB-C205` | Invalid source name |
| `TB-C206` | Split already exists in the source |
| `TB-C207` | Target directory exists and is not a tokbin source |
| `TB-C208` | Tokenizer has no end-of-sequence token |
| `TB-C209` | Tokenizer has no beginning-of-sequence token |
| `TB-C210` | Invalid configuration value |
| `TB-C211` | Special token is not in the tokenizer vocabulary |
| `TB-C212` | Tokenizer file cannot be loaded |
| `TB-C213` | Tokenizer truncation and padding were disabled |
| `TB-C214` | Writer is not finished |
| `TB-C215` | Special tokens were detected automatically |
| `TB-C216` | Not enough free disk space for the next shard |
| `TB-C301` | Split is not in the source |
| `TB-C302` | Position is out of range |
| `TB-C303` | A numpy random Generator is required |
| `TB-C304` | Window is larger than the split |
| `TB-C305` | Dataset path not found |
| `TB-C306` | Path is not a tokbin source |
| `TB-C307` | Path is a source, not a corpus |
| `TB-C308` | Output already exists |
